# testing_import_matched_id (Resource)

ImportMatchedID Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "testing_import_matched_id" "my_importmatchedid" {
  parent_entity_id = "...my_parent_entity_id..."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `parent_entity_id` (String) Requires replacement if changed.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Matched to entityId path parameter.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = testing_import_matched_id.my_testing_import_matched_id
  id = jsonencode({
    id               = "..."
    parent_entity_id = "..."
  })
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import testing_import_matched_id.my_testing_import_matched_id '{"id": "...", "parent_entity_id": "..."}'
```
